verdict.rationale: Exa lists an "API Playground" on its site and publishes an API reference page with request/response schemas, plus downloadable OpenAPI specs. That suggests an explorable reference, but the evidence never describes in-browser execution or runnable examples in any depth. A hands-on report also found the dashboard's "Get Code" cURL output incorrectly escaped, which weakens trust in generated examples. Missing for 10: documented try-it/runnable request execution inside the API reference, detail on what the Playground does, and independent confirmation that the interactive examples work correctly.
